name: Dual Family: Last Christmas
source:
Last Christmas is a small holiday special. It's a look backwards in time, when bonds were stronger, when love brought the family together over the holidays. Grab some hot cocoa, a blanket and turn on those Christmas tunes -- it's time to get comfortable!"l

[From [url=https://gumdropgames.itch.io/dualfamily]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“去年圣诞节是一个小节日特别活动。这是对过去的回顾，那时的纽带更牢固，那时爱让家人在假期里聚在一起。喝点热可可，盖上毯子，打开圣诞音乐——是时候放松一下了！”l

[来自[url=https://gumdropgames.itch.io/dualfamily]itch.io[/url]]
